ui_bugs.issue: On automated web hard-reload (page.goto direct URL) both dynamic-route screens throw 'Not authenticated' before AuthProvider hydrates AsyncStorage token; screens don't wait for auth ready before calling api(). Not reproducible via user click-through nav; can affect deep-link entry into a filled-form. Consider gating initial load() on auth ready flag.

UI shows the section but no radios, so 'Compila con Axon' remains disabled and user cannot proceed until reload. Recommend awaiting auth ready or a retry-on-401.

rca_of_issue: Auth 'Not authenticated' on deep-link into contact/[id] and filled-form/[id]: root cause is that these screens call load()->api() in their first useEffect without checking whether AuthContext has finished hydrating the token from AsyncStorage (Web IndexedDB-backed). On SPA client-side nav from an already-authenticated screen this never triggers because the token is already in memory; on hard reload / direct URL entry the API call runs first and fails. Fix: gate the initial load on `auth?.ready === true` (add a `ready` flag in AuthProvider once hydration completes) or wrap api() with a 401-retry after a short delay.
